text.text: Our Connected OR platform optimizes the surgical environment by leveraging intelligence and automation with efficiency & safety in mind, while enhancing the experience for the patient and surgical team.

Safe

Simplify your set up to minimize hazards that can cause tripping, errors, contamination, or breaks in the sterile field - keeping your focus on patient care.1

text_copy.text:
Efficient

Save time with seamless connectivity and automated workflow.1

Scalable

Future proof your OR with standardized solutions that are designed to grow with you and your evolving needs.

largeheadline.line1: What Does 25 Minutes Mean to You?
largeheadline.line2:
You can't make more time in the day, all you can do is become more efficient.
With Stryker's Connected OR, you can save 25 minutes each case.1

largeheadline.line1: Customized solutions for any space.
largeheadline.line2: Stryker’s Connected OR Platform

text.text: From your procedure rooms to your most complex Hybrid ORs, we provide a standardized, easy to use interface designed by and for your OR staff.

largeheadline.line1: Enhance your Connected OR
largeheadline.line2: Maximize your OR’s potential by customizing your solution to fit any environment

text.text: Unify your hospital information systems and medical devices with a seamless connection to EHR systems and DICOM destinations.

text_copy.text: Streamline workflows, enhance communication, and connect surgeons, staff, and patients with our media and data management solutions—designed to boost efficiency and satisfaction while helping you craft your surgical story, one edit at a time.
Connect your OR to different rooms in your facility and the rest of the world.
Take total control of your entire ecosystem from inside or outside of the sterile field.

Deliver the best in class 4K white light imaging, designed to enhance ease of use and expand advanced imaging capabilities across all specialties to improve the OR experience and advance patient care.
Protect your investment with our network of expert repair technicians that have the knowledge and training, original manufacture parts and critical components.

largeheadline.line2: Powered by Connected OR Operating System

text_copy.text: Our iSuite offers a combination of infrastructure and software that transforms the traditional operating room into a modern, state-of-the-art surgical environment for your surgical teams.
Your customized integrated OR ecosystem, designed to increase safety, operational efficiency and patient and staff satisfaction.
